messages.content: The Friday exhibition work is cleared, so the early Saturday flight is fine. Please recheck both nonstops and the real total for two of us, including the checked bag.

The Delta nonstops are still available for May 22 and May 30. Outbound flight 1950 leaves Atlanta at 8:05 a.m. and arrives St. Thomas at 11:49 a.m. The return, flight 1885, leaves at 1:35 p.m. and reaches Atlanta at 5:31 p.m. Main Cabin is $742 per traveler round trip, or $1,484. One checked bag assigned to either traveler is $35 each way, bringing the complete air total to $1,554. Seat selection is included.
Good. Are there adjacent seats with a window for me on both flights?
Yes. On the outbound, 20A and 20B are open; 20A is the window. On the return, 19A and 19B are open, again with A at the window. These are standard Main Cabin seats with no added seat fee.
Use those. Put me in the A seat and my wife beside me. Which traveler should the bag be under?

I can assign the shared checked bag to either ticket without changing the price. I have Avery Thompson in 20A outbound and 19A return, with your wife in 20B and 19B. Shall I place the bag under your name and charge the $1,554 total to the saved personal Visa ending in 6027?
Yes, put the bag under my name and use that Visa. Go ahead and book it.

Before purchase, please confirm that you authorize the $1,554 charge for two round-trip Main Cabin tickets and one checked bag each direction. The tickets are nonrefundable but retain their value as Delta eCredits if canceled before departure; fare differences would apply when rebooking.

Booked. Delta confirmation G6R2QK covers both travelers: flight 1950 from Atlanta to St. Thomas on Saturday, May 22, departing 8:05 a.m. and arriving 11:49 a.m.; flight 1885 back on Sunday, May 30, departing 1:35 p.m. and arriving Atlanta at 5:31 p.m. Your seats are 20A and 19A, and your wife’s are 20B and 19B. One checked bag is assigned to your ticket for both directions. The Visa ending in 6027 was charged $1,554, including $1,484 in airfare and $70 in baggage fees. The hotel is still unbooked.

They depart Atlanta at 8:05 a.m. on May 22 and return from St. Thomas at 1:35 p.m. on May 30, arriving Atlanta at 5:31 p.m. Adjacent seats are confirmed on both flights.
